The accepted schema-8 compiler/runtime/plugin prefix is inherited from CP-0029, but its live manifest pins the older CP-0029 gem5 binary. CP-0030 classifies the final gem5 binary as an explicit superseding execution input and does not claim that CP-0029 verify-only still passes.
